description: 用户想控制照片的清晰范围（背景虚化程度）、问"怎么拍出背景模糊/全景清晰"、 或纠结景深设置时调用。不适用于曝光量计算（应调用 exposure-dual-control）或 聚焦技术问题。 Invoke when the user wants to control the sharpness range (background blur level), asks "how to get blurred background / sharp everywhere," or is unsure about depth-of-field settings. Not for exposure calculation (use exposure-dual-control) or focus technique issues. 关键 trigger / Key triggers: "背景虚化"、"景深"、"bokeh"、"depth of field"、 "怎么让背景模糊"、"风光摄影全景清晰"、"hyperfocal distance"、 "how to blur background"、"sharp from foreground to infinity"。
